question: How can I turn a recording into text?
description: Audio Transcription in Captio AI turns an audio or video file into a written transcript you can read on your phone.
Captio AI is made for deaf and hard of hearing people, who can read a lecture or meeting recording that would otherwise be only sound.
Audio Transcription in Captio AI takes a file from Files, or a video from Photos, on iPhone and Android.
When you pick a video in Captio AI on iPhone, only its sound is taken out on the phone and sent, and the picture never leaves the device.
Sixty languages are covered by Captio AI, and speakers are separated in the transcript.
Re-transcribe in Captio AI runs a saved recording through again for a cleaner transcript.
Without internet, Captio AI still records, and the recording is transcribed automatically when the phone reconnects.
A Captio AI transcript can be shared as plain text, a link, a PDF or an email.
Download Captio AI for free with 100 free credits a day. Transcripts can contain mistakes, and you should ask first before recording a lecture or meeting.
